engine_findings: Residue DP tracks previous sign and accumulated residue; initial and position-dependent transition factors are included and length masses are summed.
Uniform shortcut is correct: its separate convolution advances at every length, including lengths whose M1 table is not uniform. Exact uniform flags inspect initial and every transition entry.
Invertible scale u permutes residue classes, so Z_uK(u*s)=Z_K(s). Orbit scans all18invertible scales and27offsets with one base normalizer.

Prefreeze canonical choice of the lexicographically smallest scale representative preserves the orbit and makes repeated scale-orbit evaluations numerically consistent. --score retains the supplied key.
Source likelihood is logsumexp of six complete-message log likelihoods minus log6. Order3 context offsets0/1/28/757 cover exactly20440histories.
Cumulative character decoding uses state differences with initial0 and centeringb. Shape probability is included; denominator is achieved STATE mass, not character mass.
Each start uses a uniform valid22weight key, seed1390000+1000*case+start, and256single-coordinate proposals; increment1..26 is uniform over other residues. Invalid proposals count against budget.
Temperature falls2.0to0.1 over proposal indices0..255; Metropolis accepts improvements or logU<difference/temperature. All evaluated proposals can update best-ever winner.
Score ties use lexicographic effective weights then b. Annealing proposals mutate the accepted base representative, while its objective is the maximum over its full orbit.

Engine has no hardcoded true key or plaintext and reads only model and anonymous packet binary paths explicitly supplied. Score/normalizer modes expose supplied candidates for later checking, not private files.
